RWA allocation sizes are wildly uneven
The chart from Arrakis Finance's latest analysis of tokenized dollar-yield products looks at the median acquisition among buyers holding at least $1M, and the spread is stark: most products sit in the $2.5M–$10.1M range, while Centrifuge's JAAA reaches $29.1M.
– sUSDe and the Syrup products: $2.5M–$2.8M
– USDY: $10.1M
– JAAA: $29.1M
This isn't a mass-market buying pattern. A small number of sophisticated allocators are writing very different cheque sizes depending on the product structure. For RWA issuers, positioning and diligence materials matter more than broad reach.
Data source:
Arrakis Finance

Solana's Alpenglow upgrade scheduled for October 21 –
Link
Solana's Alpenglow consensus upgrade is set to activate on mainnet on October 21. It replaces TowerBFT with Votor and targets transaction finality of roughly 150 milliseconds.
• Validator votes will no longer appear as standard on-chain transactions
• Reported transaction counts may fall without reflecting an actual usage drop
Faster finality could improve Solana's competitiveness for latency-sensitive apps, though post-upgrade activity metrics may be distorted.
